model.name: merge.changeRegionNotCollapsible
model.description: A foldable region that CONTAINS a change/conflict CANNOT be collapsed - STRUCTURAL: native folding is DISABLED (folding:false) and computeFoldRegions emits collapsible gaps as the COMPLEMENT of conflicts[], so a change region simply has no collapse control (non-collapsible by construction, never hidden). No foldingRangeProvider/re-expand handler.
